## seaCoverageIndex

[Implementation, line 7](sea-coverage.ts#L7)

Keep the active ocean surface separate from published tile fill BEFORE rendering,
chart creation or collision extraction. Elevated inland water and negative measured
terrain remain. Near-zero water provides the current coastal mask.

## src/planet/tiles.ts

[Source](tiles.ts)

One Web Mercator tile as a local metre plane, plus the coarse z13 relief.
The relief is split into sixteen z15 blocks so one child GLB can replace one block.
